fields.description: Enter one JSON object. Worked example: {"mode": "fixed", "fields": ["doc_id: str", "page_count: int", "note: str?"]}. Every entry in "fields" is the string "name: type", where type is one of str, int, float, bool, any, and a trailing "?" marks the field optional ("note: str?" is an optional string). Field names must be valid Python identifiers — write "doc_id", not "doc-id" or "doc.id". Modes: "fixed" accepts exactly these fields, "flexible" accepts these plus any extras the data carries, and "observed" infers every field from the data — with "observed" leave "fields" out entirely ({"mode": "observed"}).
